def _stencil(length, n, kappa, velocity, robin):
    h = length / n
    kappa = np.asarray(kappa, dtype=float)
    velocity = np.asarray(velocity, dtype=float)
    face = 2 * kappa[:-1] * kappa[1:] / (kappa[:-1] + kappa[1:]) / h**2
    diag = np.abs(velocity) / h
    diag[:-1] += face
    diag[1:] += face
